rca of the issue: Request 'POST /board/new {from_run:m9j-74af7cef0a85, mode:next_version}' returned 500. Backend log traceback pointed at /app/backend/vendored/extraction_akki/backend/services/training_lab/board_runs.py line 36. The regex `re.escape(base) + r'(?:\s+v(\d+))?'` optionally matches a trailing 'vN'; when the parent 'Language identification · 8B text model' matches with no suffix, `m.group(1)` is None and `int(None)` raises TypeError. Fix (applied): compute `int(m.group(1)) if m.group(1) else 1` inside the comprehension so unversioned names count as v1, then `max(versions + [1]) + 1`. Verified: the endpoint now returns 201 with name '... v2'.
